title: Click a cut and pick a transition from tiles
goal: Picking a transition today is a list of radio buttons with paragraphs in the side panel. Clicking a cut should open a small picker right at the cut with thumbnail tiles, as the mock draws it, with type and length as simple rows in the panel.
notes:
Intake detail (the goal as first filed, moved here by triage 2026-09-23): The transition picker is a radio list with paragraphs in the panel (TransitionInspector.swift). The mock (comp-video.html section 06, video-transitions.html) puts an AT THIS CUT popover on the edit point with thumbnail tiles, and the panel shows tidy Edit point and Transition rows with Type and Length dropdowns. Target: the user's mocks (docs/design/mocks/pages/video.html, video-shell.html, comp-video.html and the page named here) at their fidelity; runner-prompt rules on default config, side-by-side with the mock, labels-not-explanations and right-click apply. Ask throughout: would a Premiere editor get this, and is it easier here?

Filed from the 2026-09-23 video audit in the intake window.
acceptance: Clicking an edit point opens the popover with animated thumbnail tiles: Cross dissolve, Dip to black, Dip to white, Push, Wipe, Blur through, each saying whether it needs overlap
Properties shows Edit point (Outgoing, Incoming, Spare before/after) and Transition (Type and Length dropdowns) as label/value rows, no paragraphs
A transition drawn on the cut in the timeline can be lengthened by dragging its edges
Works between two different clips, not only pieces of one

log.note: triage 2026-09-23: goal rewritten in plain language, the old one kept at the top of notes
